instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_05_window_frame.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. For the steps below, launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_05_window_frame.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing frame geometry and guides to create the final window-frame profile with an outer rectangle of 160 x 100 and an inner cutout rectangle of 100 x 50. The inner window center must coincide with the outer frame center. Add one diameter 8 hole at each corner, with each hole center 15 from the nearest two sides. Add four diameter 5 secondary holes in the frame bands, with centers at (80,15), (80,85), (15,50), and (145,50). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_05.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
